our_interpretation: The firm commitment is that OpenAI raises another funding round (closes or announces a completed round) by 2027-03-31.

'Likely at a similar scale' and 'IPO likely delayed' are hedged ('likely'). They are reported as context and not scored as pass/fail tests, so a smaller round does not by itself refute the core forecast.
Early resolution rule: if OpenAI announces a closed new funding round before the evaluation date, the core forecast is settled as supported.
criteria.support_condition: OpenAI closes or announces a completed new funding round between 2026-08-18 and 2027-03-31.
criteria.contradiction_condition: By 2027-03-31 OpenAI has raised no new round (for example, it funds itself through an IPO or operations instead).
